name: SWE-Compass
description: SWE-Compass is a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate agentic coding abilities of large language models across diverse programming tasks, scenarios, and languages. It unifies heterogeneous code-related evaluations into a structured, production-aligned framework with 2000 high-quality instances curated from real GitHub pull requests.
reputation: A very recent benchmark that is gaining attention for evaluating real-world, agentic coding skills across diverse software-engineering tasks, but it is not yet broadly established.
notes: Covers 8 task types, 8 programming scenarios, and 10 programming languages; curated from authentic GitHub pull requests; aligns evaluation with real-world developer practices.
